boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 111 stacks two purple-framed chambers that share a single vertical drop lane through a yellow down-arrow tile. The right-side combo column counts from 9 down to 0, tracking consecutive clears. The upper board must thin enough for the red L-piece to move — otherwise it blocks the yellow arrow lane and the lower `14` counter never starts dropping.
landmarks: Block Out Level 111 stacks two purple-framed chambers that share a single vertical drop lane through a yellow down-arrow tile.
The right-side combo column counts from 9 down to 0, tracking consecutive clears.
The upper board must thin enough for the red L-piece to move — otherwise it blocks the yellow arrow lane and the lower `14` counter never starts dropping.

quickTips: The yellow down-arrow is a one-way gate — do not park the upper red L-piece on it.
Peel the left purple cross-pattern block before feeding the lower yellow L-piece rightward.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Remove the top orange horizontal bar and the left purple column in the upper chamber to open the top `2`/`3` row.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Peel the center blue cluster downward without blocking the yellow down-arrow tile.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Shift the upper red L-piece rightward so the yellow arrow lane stays open for the lower chamber.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Drop the cleared upper pieces through the yellow arrow into the lower grid once the left cross-pattern block thins.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Slide the lower yellow L-piece rightward before feeding the blue verticals out through the `15` side exit.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the remaining lower-board pieces and close the purple bottom bar counter `14`.

failurePoints: Parking the upper red L-piece on the yellow down-arrow, which blocks the lower `14` feed.
Moving the lower yellow L-piece before the upper board has cleared around the arrow lane.
